{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing values in either flipper_length_mm or body_mass_g
filtered_df = df.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g'])

# Compute Pearson correlation between flipper_length_mm and body_mass_g
pearson_corr = filtered_df['flipper_length_mm'].corr(filtered_df['body_mass_g'])

# Print the correlation value directly
print(pearson_corr)"}
